Install slack-desktop on Omarchy

Slack Desktop for Linux

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add slack-desktop
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.52.178-1:
    pacman -Qi slack-desktop

Open and use slack-desktop

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql slack-desktop

Frequently asked questions

How do I install slack-desktop on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add slack-desktop. The download is 122.7 MB and it takes 339 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is slack-desktop free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed custom.

How do I uninstall slack-desktop?

Run omarchy pkg drop slack-desktop. It removes the package from your system.

What does slack-desktop depend on?

The package declares 27 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, cairo, dbus, expat, fontconfig, gcc-libs, glib2, glibc, gtk3, libcups, libnotify and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is slack-desktop in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as slack-desktop (version 4.52.178-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://slack.com/downloads.
